Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-dont-underestimate-our-chances/ SWCCG Cards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_Don_t_Underestimate_Our_Chances.png source photograph].
